page.overview:
Who is Rokuta Kamado?

Like the rest of his family, Rokuta had light skin and eyes with white pupils. The upper part of his irises was black, while the lower ones were dark red. He wore his black hair in a bowl-cut. Rokuta wore a blue kimono with white diamond patterns, checkered pants, and white socks.

While not much of his personality is known other than him acting like a typical toddler, Rokuta seemed to have a good relationship with his parents and siblings.

Rokuta grew up on a mountain alongside his older siblings and mother. He was the youngest son of the Kamado family.

It appeared that Rokuta had a positive relationship with his father, as Nezuko mentioned him to be lonely and clingy to Tanjiro after their father's death.
